content: SQLAlchemy 2.0 async atomic guard pattern: result = await session.execute(update(AdminJob).where(AdminJob.id==job_id, AdminJob.current_step=='ingest', AdminJob.status=='completed').values(status='running', current_step='parse')); if result.rowcount == 0: return (skip spawn). asyncpg supports sane_rowcount so result.rowcount is reliable for UPDATE. CursorResult.rowcount returns count matched by WHERE clause regardless of whether values changed. Not available if using RETURNING clause.
